name: Fort Shrine
player_description: A small shrine stands near the south wall. The official dedication is to Mars Ultor. Someone has added a second dedication alongside it -- a name in Romano-Celtic letters that the soldiers have stopped trying to pronounce. Offerings of small coins and grain sit at the base. The stone feels older than the fort.
gm_notes: DC 13 Religion: Belatucadrus, Celtic war god of the frontier, known in the north as 'the Beautiful Shining One' -- conceals Belenus (Celtic sun god). DC 15: the dual dedication is unusual; normally Roman and Celtic dedications are separated. DC 17: the stone itself predates the fort by at least a century. Someone built the fort's shrine around a rock that was already here. Corruption track note: players who make offerings at this shrine gain advantage on their first Religion check of the next session.
